name: Rent support review
guidance:
1. Choose a case. Go to the work queue at http://localhost:8787/demo/cm/queue.html and open the case you want to work on: Pick up the next case offers the oldest one that isn’t done. Power Loader takes the case reference from the case you open.
2. Case. Clip the case page: the client’s details and the references for the other systems.
3. Ask the client for a missing reference. Only if the case has no Harbour Homes tenancy reference: open the email, check it and send it, then wait for the reply. Power Loader passes over this step for a case that has one.
4. Harbour Homes tenancy. Clip the rent account. If its address differs from the case, check which is current before you go on.
5. Employment and income record. Clip it. If Power Loader says it may be a different person, stop: the reference has been reused, so don’t use the record.
6. Customer messages. On the client’s messages, press Fetch: Power Loader reads all six messages, 4 at a time and clips any change of circumstances (effective date, new weekly income, tenancy end date).
7. Rent support review. Fill the form from the case, write your recommendation yourself, check every box and submit.
8. Tell the income team. Open the email, check it and send it. Then mark the case done on its case page and pick up the next one.
The team’s own procedure, for doing the same review by hand, is on the staff intranet.

email.subject: Your rent support review: case {ref}
email.body:
Dear {firstName} {lastName},

We are reviewing the help you get with your rent (case {ref}). To finish the review we need your Harbour Homes tenancy reference. You can find it on your tenancy agreement or on any letter from Harbour Homes, and it starts with HH-.

Please reply to this email with the reference, quoting case {ref}.

Thank you,
Housing Support Team
Northshire Council

step.text: Open this email in your email app, check it and send it, then wait for the client’s reply with their Harbour Homes tenancy reference.

annotations.html: Read every message. A change of circumstances can be in any online form. Use the step’s Fetch button rather than opening each one.

step.text: A change of circumstances can be in any of the client’s online forms, and the list doesn’t say which. Press Fetch to read all six messages, 4 at a time: Power Loader clips the effective date, the new weekly income and any tenancy end date from the ones that have them.

step.text: Once the review is submitted, open this email in your email app, check the arrears and the tenancy reference in it, and send it. Then mark the case done on its case page.
